title: APG architecture overlay v0.1 (logical layer assignment per file)
description: Plan #15 Step B output. Identifies 3-10 logical layers across the project and assigns every file to exactly one with a confidence + reason. Layers are project-natural (a cpp engine might be 'Sim/Fields/Engine/Tools/Build'; a React app might be 'API/Service/UI/State'). Consumed by the visual dashboard for color-grouping and by briefs for a high-level orientation section.

generatorVersion.description: Version of the architecture-layer-assigner that produced this output.

graphHead.description: Git rev the inputs were drawn from.

inputSha.description: sha256 of the combined (structural extract + semantic.files.json) input that fed the LLM.

id.description: Stable kebab/snake id (lowercase). Referenced by assignments.

description.description: 1-2 sentence description of what this layer is responsible for.

color.description: Hex color used by the dashboard for node grouping. LLM picks from a palette; validator may normalize.

estimatedFileCount.description: LLM estimate of files in this layer at generation time. Validator confirms against actual assignment count.

assignments.description: Object map: file path → assignment record. EVERY path appearing here must exist in the paired semantic-files.json. EVERY layerId must reference a layers[].id. Validators enforce both.

confidence.description: Assignment confidence. Dashboard color-fades low-confidence; briefs flag them.

reason.description: Short justification (e.g. 'imports from data layer, exported via api router' or 'path prefix src/ui/ + JSX exports').

filesUnassigned.description: Should be 0 if validator passes — every file must have an assignment.
